title: Passport Processing
description: Validate passport fields by presence and then by value constraints.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse passport blocks (separated by blank lines) into dictionaries of key-value pairs, then apply two levels of validation.

## Part 1

Check that all 7 required fields (`byr`, `iyr`, `eyr`, `hgt`, `hcl`, `ecl`, `pid`) are present. The `cid` field is optional.

## Part 2

Additionally validate each field's value: year ranges for birth/issue/expiration, height in cm or inches within bounds, hair color as a hex code, eye color from a fixed set, and passport ID as exactly 9 digits.
